guides.title: Install the app
guides.summary: Download YaraConnect from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

steps.title: Open your app store
steps.android: Open the Play Store on your phone.
steps.ios: Open the App Store on your iPhone.

steps.title: Search for Yara Connect
steps.android: Search "Yara Connect" and tap the first result.
steps.ios: Search "Yara Connect" and tap the first result.

steps.title: Install
steps.android: Tap Install, sign in with your Google account if asked, and wait for it to finish.
steps.ios: Tap Get, confirm with Face ID or your password, and wait for it to finish.

steps.title: Pick country and language
steps.android: Open the app, select the country where your shop is, then your language.
steps.ios: Open the app, select the country where your shop is, then your language.

guides.tip: You can also download it from the YaraConnect website: rewards.yaradigital.com

guides.title: Register your shop
guides.summary: Create your account with your personal details, shop details and your dealer's code.

steps.title: Agree to the terms
steps.android: Read the terms and conditions, tap Agree, then tap I accept.
steps.ios: Read the terms and conditions, tap Agree, then tap I accept.

steps.title: Enter your details
steps.android: Fill in your name and contact details, then tap Next.
steps.ios: Fill in your name and contact details, then tap Next.

steps.title: Enter shop details
steps.android: Enter your shop name, address, province and district, then tap Next.
steps.ios: Enter your shop name, address, province and district, then tap Next.

steps.title: Enter your dealer code
steps.android: Type the referral code your dealer gave you and tap Submit.
steps.ios: Type the referral code your dealer gave you and tap Submit.

guides.tip: Ask your dealer for the code before you start. Without it, your account can't be linked to them.
problems: I don't have a dealer code

guides.title: Verify your account
guides.summary: Confirm your phone number so Yara can approve your shop.

steps.title: Check your country
steps.android: Make sure the country shown is correct (for example Thailand).
steps.ios: Make sure the country shown is correct (for example Thailand).

steps.title: Enter your phone number
steps.android: Type the phone number you registered with.
steps.ios: Type the phone number you registered with.

steps.title: Enter the code
steps.android: Type the one-time code sent by SMS, then tap to continue.
steps.ios: Type the one-time code sent by SMS, then tap to continue.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.android: You land on the Home screen. Approval usually takes up to 10 minutes.
steps.ios: You land on the Home screen. Approval usually takes up to 10 minutes.

next.label: OR · REJECTED
next.text: Check the reason and contact support

problems: I didn't get the SMS code

guides.title: Set your shop location and photo
guides.summary: Add your shop's GPS location and a photo so Yara and farmers can find you.
before: You are standing in your shop

steps.title: Open Account
steps.android: On the home screen, tap Account.
steps.ios: On the home screen, tap Account.

steps.title: Tap GPS location
steps.android: In Account settings, tap GPS location.
steps.ios: In Account settings, tap GPS location.

steps.title: Confirm you are at the shop
steps.android: Tap "Yes, I am at my shop" and allow location access.
steps.ios: Tap "Yes, I am at my shop" and allow location access.

steps.title: Add a shop photo
steps.android: Back on Home, tap Upload photo, take the photo, rotate if needed and confirm.
steps.ios: Back on Home, tap Upload photo, take the photo, rotate if needed and confirm.

guides.tip: Only set the location while you are physically at the shop. You can tap Update later if you move.

guides.title: Add branches and shop assistants
guides.summary: Add branch shops under your account and invite staff to help scan and take orders.

steps.title: Open My shops
steps.android: Go to Account, then My shops.
steps.ios: Go to Account, then My shops.

steps.title: Add a branch
steps.android: Tap Add shop, enter the branch details and upload its documents and tax ID.
steps.ios: Tap Add shop, enter the branch details and upload its documents and tax ID.

steps.title: Invite an assistant
steps.android: Tap Staff, then Invite, and enter the assistant's phone number.
steps.ios: Tap Staff, then Invite, and enter the assistant's phone number.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.android: Yara approves new branches in the Admin Portal.
steps.ios: Yara approves new branches in the Admin Portal.

guides.tip: Shop assistants can't manage shops or redeem rewards. In Thailand, dealer branches don't earn points.

guides.title: Update your stock
guides.summary: Keep product, size, price and quantity up to date so farmers see what you have.

steps.title: Open Stock
steps.android: From the home screen, tap Stock.
steps.ios: From the home screen, tap Stock.

steps.title: Pick a product
steps.android: Choose the product and pack size you want to update.
steps.ios: Choose the product and pack size you want to update.

steps.title: Change quantity or price
steps.android: Edit the retail price or quantity, then tap Save.
steps.ios: Edit the retail price or quantity, then tap Save.

guides.tip: Dealer stock is synced from Yara's system. Dealers can only reduce stock by hand, to record offline sales.

next.label: AVAILABLE
next.text: Total minus stock held by pending farmer orders

next.label: PENDING
next.text: Reserved for farmer orders not yet completed

guides.title: Set up your online shop
guides.summary: Add photos, opening hours and a description that farmers see in Yara FarmCare.

steps.title: Open Shop profile
steps.android: Go to Account, then Shop profile.
steps.ios: Go to Account, then Shop profile.

steps.title: Add details
steps.android: Add a photo, phone number, opening hours and a short description.
steps.ios: Add a photo, phone number, opening hours and a short description.

steps.title: Publish
steps.android: Tap Save. Farmers can now find your shop in the FarmCare app.
steps.ios: Tap Save. Farmers can now find your shop in the FarmCare app.

guides.title: Handle farmer orders
guides.summary: Accept, prepare and complete orders farmers place in Yara FarmCare.

steps.title: Open the new order
steps.android: Tap the notification, or go to Orders → To review.
steps.ios: Tap the notification, or go to Orders → To review.

steps.title: Accept or decline
steps.android: Check the products and tap Accept. If you decline, choose a reason.
steps.ios: Check the products and tap Accept. If you decline, choose a reason.

steps.title: Hand over the products
steps.android: When the farmer collects, scan their QR code or enter their code.
steps.ios: When the farmer collects, scan their QR code or enter their code.

steps.title: Complete the order
steps.android: Tap Complete. It moves to Past orders.
steps.ios: Tap Complete. It moves to Past orders.

next.label: ACCEPTED
next.text: Farmer is told to come and collect

guides.title: Orders from basic phones (USSD)
guides.summary: Some farmers order by basic phone. Their orders show as "USSD user".

steps.title: Find the order
steps.android: USSD orders appear in Orders with the farmer's phone number only.
steps.ios: USSD orders appear in Orders with the farmer's phone number only.

steps.title: Accept and complete
steps.android: Accept, hand over and complete the order the same way as app orders.
steps.ios: Accept, hand over and complete the order the same way as app orders.

guides.tip: Call the farmer on the number shown if you need to confirm anything.

guides.title: Order for a farmer (assisted order)
guides.summary: Create an order on behalf of a farmer who is in your shop.

steps.title: Start an assisted order
steps.android: Tap Assisted order and enter the farmer's phone number.
steps.ios: Tap Assisted order and enter the farmer's phone number.

steps.title: Confirm with the farmer's code
steps.android: Ask the farmer for the one-time code they receive by SMS.
steps.ios: Ask the farmer for the one-time code they receive by SMS.

steps.title: Add products
steps.android: Add products, apply any coupon or referral code, and check the final price.
steps.ios: Add products, apply any coupon or referral code, and check the final price.

steps.title: Complete
steps.android: Tap Complete. Use Back to shop within 30 minutes to place another order for the same farmer.
steps.ios: Tap Complete. Use Back to shop within 30 minutes to place another order for the same farmer.

guides.title: Invite farmers (Farmers club)
guides.summary: Share your QR code or link so farmers join FarmCare and land on your shop.

steps.title: Open Farmers club
steps.android: From the home screen, tap Farmers club.
steps.ios: From the home screen, tap Farmers club.

steps.title: Share your QR or link
steps.android: Show your QR code, or share the link by chat app.
steps.ios: Show your QR code, or share the link by chat app.

guides.title: Get paid with M-Pesa
guides.summary: Add your M-Pesa paybill or till number to your online shop.

steps.title: Open Payments
steps.android: Go to Shop profile → Payments.
steps.ios: Go to Shop profile → Payments.

steps.title: Add your number
steps.android: Enter your paybill or till number and tap Save.
steps.ios: Enter your paybill or till number and tap Save.

guides.title: Order from Yara (DOS)
guides.summary: Order stock directly from Yara by floor load or sling, in tonnes or bags.

steps.title: Open Order from Yara
steps.android: From the home screen, tap Order from Yara.
steps.ios: From the home screen, tap Order from Yara.

steps.title: Choose products
steps.android: Pick products by family. Choose floor load, sling or both, and enter the quantity in MT or bags.
steps.ios: Pick products by family. Choose floor load, sling or both, and enter the quantity in MT or bags.

steps.title: Add delivery details
steps.android: Enter truck number, pick-up date (today to 7 days ahead), payment terms and PO number.
steps.ios: Enter truck number, pick-up date (today to 7 days ahead), payment terms and PO number.

steps.title: Submit
steps.android: Check the summary and tap Submit. The order is sent to Yara.
steps.ios: Check the summary and tap Submit. The order is sent to Yara.

guides.tip: A sling is a bundle of 2 MT (Urea/NPK) or 1.6 MT (organic).
problems: My order was cancelled after 30 days

guides.title: Track a Yara order
guides.summary: See the status of your orders and chat with Yara about them.

steps.title: Open My orders
steps.android: Go to Order from Yara → My orders.
steps.ios: Go to Order from Yara → My orders.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.android: Pending is grey, Completed is green, Declined or Failed is red.
steps.ios: Pending is grey, Completed is green, Declined or Failed is red.

steps.title: Chat with Yara
steps.android: Open an order and tap Chat to ask Yara staff about it.
steps.ios: Open an order and tap Chat to ask Yara staff about it.

guides.title: Order from your distributor (retailer)
guides.summary: Order stock from your distributor in the app.

steps.title: Open Order stock
steps.android: From the home screen, tap Order stock.
steps.ios: From the home screen, tap Order stock.

steps.title: Add products
steps.android: Pick products and quantities.
steps.ios: Pick products and quantities.

steps.title: Send the order
steps.android: Tap Send. Your distributor reviews it.
steps.ios: Tap Send. Your distributor reviews it.

guides.title: Approve retailer orders (distributor)
guides.summary: Review, edit and approve orders your retailers send you.

steps.title: Open Retailer orders
steps.android: Tap the notification, or go to Orders → Retailer orders.
steps.ios: Tap the notification, or go to Orders → Retailer orders.

steps.title: Review and edit
steps.android: Check the products. You can change quantity or price before approving.
steps.ios: Check the products. You can change quantity or price before approving.

steps.title: Approve or decline
steps.android: Tap Approve. For Direct orders, the order then goes to Yara.
steps.ios: Tap Approve. For Direct orders, the order then goes to Yara.

guides.tip: Orders with no activity are cancelled automatically after 30 days.

guides.title: Earn points with a receipt
guides.summary: Take a photo of your Yara purchase receipt. Yara checks it and adds points to your account.
before: The whole receipt is clear and flat

steps.title: Tap the camera button
steps.android: On the home screen, tap the camera (Scan) button at the bottom.
steps.ios: On the home screen, tap the camera (Scan) button at the bottom centre.

steps.title: Take a photo of the receipt
steps.android: Fit the whole receipt in the frame, or choose a photo from your gallery.
steps.ios: Fit the whole receipt in the frame, or tap Photos to choose one you already took.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.android: Rotate the photo if needed, then tap Submit to send it for review.
steps.ios: Rotate the photo if needed, then tap Submit to send it for review.

steps.title: See it in Transaction history
steps.android: Your receipt shows a clock icon while it is pending approval.
steps.ios: Your receipt shows a clock icon while it is pending approval.

guides.tip: Photograph the receipt on a flat surface in good light. Blurry or cut-off receipts are the most common reason for rejection.

next.label: 2 · APPROVED
next.text: Points are added to your account

next.label: OR · REJECTED
next.text: Tap the receipt to see why, then resubmit

guides.title: Scan QR codes
guides.summary: Scan the QR code on a Yara bag to earn points straight away.
before: The QR sticker is not torn

steps.title: Tap Scan
steps.android: On the home screen, tap the Scan button.
steps.ios: On the home screen, tap the Scan button.

steps.title: Point at the QR code
steps.android: Hold the phone about 15 cm from the sticker until it beeps.
steps.ios: Hold the phone about 15 cm from the sticker until it vibrates.

steps.title: Check your points
steps.android: A green tick shows the points you just earned.
steps.ios: A green tick shows the points you just earned.

guides.tip: You can scan up to 50 bags at once, or save up to 50 scans offline and send them later. Points arrive within 24 hours.

guides.title: Check your transaction history
guides.summary: See every receipt and QR scan, and whether points were added.
before: You have submitted at least one receipt or scan

steps.title: Open History
steps.android: On the home screen, tap History.
steps.ios: On the home screen, tap History.

steps.title: Open a transaction
steps.android: Tap a transaction to see its details.
steps.ios: Tap a transaction to see its details.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.android: Pending means it's waiting for approval. Approved receipts show a green mark; otherwise you'll see Receipt rejected.
steps.ios: Pending means it's waiting for approval. Approved receipts show a green mark; otherwise you'll see Receipt rejected.

guides.tip: Pull down on the list to refresh it.

guides.title: Redeem a reward
guides.summary: Use your points for a discount coupon or reward.

steps.title: Open Rewards
steps.android: On the home screen, tap Rewards.
steps.ios: On the home screen, tap Rewards.

steps.title: Choose a reward
steps.android: Pick a reward and choose the discount amount, then tap Next.
steps.ios: Pick a reward and choose the discount amount, then tap Next.

steps.title: Send the request
steps.android: Tap Send request, then Done.
steps.ios: Tap Send request, then Done.

steps.title: Track the status
steps.android: In My Rewards the request shows Pending. You can cancel it here until it's approved.
steps.ios: In My Rewards the request shows Pending. You can cancel it here until it's approved.

next.label: OR · REJECTED
next.text: Points go back to your balance

steps.ios: Tap Contact us, pick a topic and write a short description.
